sources.entry: Lilypond UI - Create beautiful musical scores with LilyPond.

summary.one_liner: A macOS editor for LilyPond music notation with syntax highlighting, inline error messages, and a live score preview.
summary.what_it_does: LilyPond-UI is a macOS app for writing and editing LilyPond scores. It provides syntax highlighting and in-line error and warning messages for LilyPond source. The code editor and preview window sit side by side and their sizes can be adjusted. Saving or re-rendering compiles the score and shows the result. The app also gives access to the raw LilyPond output for debugging.
use_cases: Previewing engraved sheet music while typing
Typesetting sheet music on a Mac
how_to_run: Install the macOS build of LilyPond from the LilyPond website (link not given in README).
Download the most recent LilyPond.Editor.dmg from the GitHub releases.
Open LilyPond.Editor.dmg and drag LilyPond Editor.app into your Applications folder.
Launch LilyPond Editor, open a score, and start writing.
notable: Live re-render on save (⌘s) and manual re-render (⌘r)
Adjustable two-up code and preview panes
Access to raw LilyPond output for debugging
caveats: macOS only; other platforms are not yet supported.
Requires a separate install of the macOS LilyPond build.
